More recently HER2 targeting antibody-drug conjugate (ADC), Trastuzumab deruxtecan has shown benefit in HER2-expressing gynecological cancers. Through systematic review and meta-analysis, data on HER2 overexpression was pooled from nine retrospective studies in five countries encompassing 769 patients with predominantly VSCC, and 50 HER2-positive cases were observed.
